title: Sandy Boardwalk | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Gulf Front + Private Pool and Beach- Sandy Boardwalk by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Sandy Boardwalk by Royal Destinations Location: Seagrove Beach Address: 54 Seashore Circle, Santa Rosa Beach Details: A perfect escape for families looking to enjoy the white sand beaches of 30A. This beautiful beachfront home is located in the private, gated community of Seashore Village, on the southside of 30A in Seagrove Beach. This gem of a home features a personal boardwalk to a private beach (shared by only 12 homes). Sandy Boardwalk is 4,900+ square feet of Gulf facing comfort for up to 20 guests. This 7-bedroom, 7.5-bathroom home offers unobstructed panoramic views of the stunning Gulf coast from both levels of the house and includes a private heated pool, a carriage house, private boardwalk straight to the sugar-white sand beach, a game room, parking for up to 5 cars, six bicycles to explore the area and three complimentary beach chair setups (3 umbrellas, 6 chairs from 3/1-10/31). This spacious Gulf front home is the ideal layout for multi-family or multi-generational family vacations and girlfriend getaway trips. Each of the 7 spacious bedrooms offers private suite bathrooms. For guests who may not be a fan of stairs, on the main floor is a guest bedroom with a king-sized bed and full bathroom. The main floor also offers a game room with a full-sized pool table and a ping-pong table, ideal for when the weather does not cooperate. The private pool with its private covered cabana space is located just off the kitchen area, ideal for keeping an eye on little ones as parents prepare meals or relax in the cabana. Sandy Boardwalk features a personal boardwalk with built in bench seating to enjoy the spectacular sunsets. During the holidays, you can comfortably watch Seaside and Rosemary Beach fireworks from your own boardwalk! Home Highlights: - Distance to Beach Access: Gulf Front, Private Boardwalk to Private Beach - Walking distance to restaurants and shops on 30A and Greenway Station - Two miles to Seaside - Panoramic views from both floors - Parking: 1 garage space, 4 spaces in driveway - Fully appointed kitchen - Gas Grill Available (Propane Provided) - Carriage house to accommodate multiple families - Nespresso Vertuo Coffee Machine - *Private Heated Pool *Pool heat is available for an additional $300 (pre-tax). The pool heater requires 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 20 7 Beds / 7.5 Baths Main House: 5 Beds / 5.5 Baths First Floor: -Bedroom 1: King Bed with Private Bath -Bedroom 2: King Bed with Private Bath -Laundry Room Second Floor: -Bedroom 3: King Bed and Twin/Twin Bunk with Private Bath -Bedroom 4: King Bed and Twin/Twin Bunk with Private Bath -Bedroom 5: Two Twin Beds with Private Bath Guest House: 2 Beds / 2 Baths -Bedroom 6: King Bed with Twin/Twin Bunk and Private Bath -Bedroom 7: Queen Bed with Shared Bath Amenities Include: -6 Adult Bikes -3 Beach Service Sets* *Seasonal: March – October Please Note: Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
